description: Search 2,000+ Virtuoso hotels, plus packages, cruises and private experiences, by place, brand or kind of stay. Results show whether Virtuoso perks apply, a trip_id for get_trip_details, and how to book. No live rates: the advisor quotes them.

destination.description: A city, region or country ("Paris", "Tuscany", "Caribbean"), a hotel or brand ("Four Seasons"), both ("Four Seasons Paris"), or a kind of stay ("beach", "safari")

offset.description: Results to skip, for the next page

trip_type.description: hotel_only (the default), fixed_package, cruise, service (private experiences) or custom_itinerary

name: search_trips
